title: CSS Examples
description: Copy-ready CSS snippets and complete pages for common jobs: cards, buttons, navigation bars, centred heroes, responsive grids, sticky headers, spinners, fluid type and dark mode.

examples.title: Style the sample page
examples.description: A small, complete stylesheet for the playground's sample page: typeface, heading colour, link style, list markers and a card.

examples.title: Zebra-striped list
examples.description: Alternating row backgrounds with :nth-child(), a hover highlight and no border after the last item.

examples.title: Card component
examples.description: A card with border-box sizing, padding, rounded corners, a layered shadow and a heading that sits flush with the top.

examples.title: Button with hover and focus states
examples.description: A button that lifts and darkens on hover, shows a clear focus ring for keyboard users and transitions smoothly in both directions.

examples.title: Fluid typography
examples.description: Headings and body text that scale smoothly between a minimum and a maximum with clamp(), plus a comfortable line length.

examples.title: Centred hero section
examples.description: A full-height section with its content centred on both axes using flexbox and a dynamic viewport height.
